method.eventDriver: node.exe fetch; no shell command used per event

interpretation: The 100-event driver started only node.exe and all events completed over authenticated loopback HTTP. No dev-pomogator command in the measured path invoked bash.exe. The machine-wide bash process count decreased during the run; that count includes unrelated concurrent sessions and is not used as a causal kernel-pool claim.
remainingEvidence: A separate one-hour Security 4798 and PoolMon before/after comparison with WSL running is still required before attributing kernel-pool growth to the old hook transport.
